tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Screen background — airy sky. Every kid and parent screen sits on it.

tokens.name: color-bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, idle answer tiles (gradient start), trays, bottom nav, modals.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Indigo structure: CTA fill (white text on it), idle answer-tile text, active nav icon, in-progress mastery pips. Reads 6.3:1 on color-bg-card.

tokens.name: color-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft indigo: idle tile 4px border, active-nav pill, empty pips, path line, card borders.

tokens.name: color-primary-ink
tokens.usage: Deep indigo: headings, titles and big kid-facing numbers/equations on color-bg and color-bg-card.

tokens.name: color-primary-tint
tokens.usage: Gradient end of .kid-tile-idle (color-bg-card → color-primary-tint). Its own hue, not an alpha of primary. Not overridden by any alternate palette — in deepsea the tile gradient still ends on this light tint (flagged).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: REWARD ONLY: mastered ring, mastered pips, celebration stars, the "N skills mastered" card. Never for warnings, review-due or wrong answers.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Reward card background (gold "N skills mastered" card, mastery-up beat). color-ink on it.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Correct answer: tile fill + border, compare blank fill. White text on it reads only 2.28:1 in wonder — kept as the source has it; flagged.

tokens.name: color-success-soft
tokens.usage: Pale correct tint for success surfaces.

tokens.name: color-encourage
tokens.usage: Wrong answer (soft coral, never red, never amber): wrong-tile 4px border.

tokens.name: color-encourage-soft
tokens.usage: Wrong-tile fill.

tokens.name: color-encourage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-encourage-soft (wrong-tile label) — 4.56:1, warm and readable, not alarming.

tokens.name: color-learn
tokens.usage: Hint / learning sky: hint-bubble border, "Tinku suggests" path ring, compare wrong-reveal fill.

tokens.name: color-learn-soft
tokens.usage: Hint-bubble fill, "currently working on" strip, offline banner.

tokens.name: color-learn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-learn-soft and color-bg: hint text, "Tinku suggests!" label (5.2:1).

tokens.name: color-review
tokens.usage: Review-due ONLY ("come back to this"): teal ring and ↻ cue. Any future "needs attention" state inherits teal, never amber. Its label text uses color-ink.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary body and question-sentence text on color-bg, color-bg-card, color-accent-soft and color-learn-soft (≥12:1).

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, path node descriptions, parent meta. 4.76:1 on color-bg-card but 4.46:1 on color-bg (wonder), 4.12 in sunset — just under 4.5; flagged, kept as source.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Compact equations in the quiz (text-question). Fluid in code: clamp(3rem, 9vh, 4.75rem) — this is the ceiling. color-primary-ink plus .kid-num-3d. Prompts over 20 chars drop to prompt.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and "Great job!" in color-primary-ink. Fluid: clamp(1.6rem, 6vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: Kid-facing question sentence in color-ink (extrabold for count, bold for compare). Fluid: clamp(1.15rem, 4.5vw, 1.5rem).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body and subtitles; parent surfaces. Fluid: clamp(0.95rem, 3.4vw, 1.1rem).

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Hint bubble text (font-semibold leading-snug) in color-learn-ink.

spacing.note: The app uses Tailwind's default 4px-step scale; these are the named rules the docs fix.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (px-4).

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Wider screen gutter (px-5).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target for every kid control.

tokens.name: tile-height-max
tokens.usage: Answer tile height ceiling; fluid clamp(3rem, 11vh, 5rem) in code.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Answer tiles, CTA buttons (rounded-button).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, hint bubble, modal, trays (rounded-card).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, nav pill, mastery pips, path medallions (rounded-full).

shadow.note: Static only — never animated. Tints follow each palette's ink/primary channels.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Layered pillow on answer tiles and CTAs.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, hint bubble, path medallions.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav top edge.

duration.note: Animate transform/opacity only; every one collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-screen
tokens.usage: view-enter screen transition, q-enter question slide.

tokens.name: dur-option-in
tokens.usage: opt-in tile entrance; stagger 45ms per tile.

tokens.name: dur-correct
tokens.usage: correct-pop on the right tile, with the chime.

tokens.name: dur-wrong
tokens.usage: encourage-nudge — gentle 3px sway, never a shake.

tokens.name: dur-hint
tokens.usage: hint-pop spring on the bubble.

tokens.name: dur-mascot-swap
tokens.usage: Tinku pose cross-fade.

tokens.name: dur-breathe
tokens.usage: Tinku idle breathe loop (4px float).

tokens.name: dur-path-pulse
tokens.usage: Sonar pulse on the suggested path node.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Pops: hint-pop, slot-fill, celebrate-pop, star-pop, card-in-suggest.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: q-enter, opt-in, rise-in, view-enter.
